name: FIR-Bench-Sin-Doc-FinQA
description: A document-grounded financial question-answering benchmark (involving Sinhala) that measures models' ability to read financial documents and perform numerical and multi-hop reasoning to produce correct answers. It focuses on extracting and computing numerical facts from document context and evaluates robustness on finance-domain queries. The benchmark targets models for low-resource language financial QA and document understanding.
reputation: A niche dataset aimed at financial document QA in a low-resource language; useful to a smaller community working on finance and multilingual/document QA.
